criteria.description: BackendType returns fips and fips validates as a DNSBackendType.
SyncZone writes deterministic FIPS hosts entries for npub and fd00::/8 values using atomic temp-file replacement.
SyncZone preserves manual entries outside the Bahia-managed section and replaces prior managed entries.
ListRecords parses .fips hosts entries back into CNAME-like DNSRecord values.
Health reports accessible readable/writable hosts files and fails for missing paths.
Records whose values are not npub or fd00::/8 are skipped instead of written to FIPS hosts.
